children: Shetty succeeds Sarju Simaria, who was elevated as Executive Director and Whole-time Director in 2026

Utkarsh Small Finance Bank has appointed Manmohan Shetty as its Chief Financial Officer (CFO), following the elevation of its previous CFO, Sarju Simaria, as Executive Director and Whole-time Director.
The appointment was facilitated by executive search firm Venator Search Partners, according to a company statement issued on 22 September 2026.

Shetty is a Chartered Accountant with more than 23 years of experience across banking and financial services. He most recently served as CFO of IREP Credit Capital and previously held senior leadership roles at Barclays in India, including as CFO of its non-banking finance company.
His experience includes financial oversight, governance, capital management, regulatory reporting and business planning across regulated financial institutions.

The appointment follows a succession process that began with Simaria's appointment as CFO in 2022. Simaria was elevated to Executive Director and Whole-time Director in 2026, after which the bank initiated the search for his successor.

Commenting on the appointment, Deepraditya Datta, Founder of Venator Search Partners, said Shetty brings experience across banking and NBFCs and the experience required to manage the responsibilities of the CFO's office.

The appointment comes as small finance banks focus on areas including profitability, asset quality, capital planning and regulatory compliance, with finance functions increasingly covering strategy, risk, governance and business planning alongside financial reporting.
